meaning:
ἀσωτία, -ας, ή
(ἀ- neg., σώζω), [in LXX: Pro.28:7 (זָלַל), 2Ma.6:4 * ;]
prodigality, wastefulness, profligacy: Eph.5:18, Tit.1:6, 1Pe.4:4 (MM, see word).†
SYN.: ἀσέλγεια, q.v (AS)

elsewhere.note: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming.
